SELECT users.id AS users_id, users.display_name AS users_display_name, users.email AS users_email, users.username AS users_username, users.password_hash AS users_password_hash, users.role AS users_role, users.access_level AS users_access_level, users.company_name AS users_company_name, users.phone AS users_phone, users.phone_extension AS users_phone_extension, users.shipping_name AS users_shipping_name, users.shipping_address AS users_shipping_address, users.billing_address AS users_billing_address, users.shipping_same_as_billing AS users_shipping_same_as_billing, users.assigned_promo_code AS users_assigned_promo_code, users.assigned_discount_percent AS users_assigned_discount_percent, users.approval_status AS users_approval_status, users.approval_decided_at AS users_approval_decided_at, users.approval_decided_by_user_id AS users_approval_decided_by_user_id, users.is_active AS users_is_active, users.created_at AS users_created_at 
FROM users 
WHERE users.id = ?

SELECT users.id, users.display_name, users.email, users.username, users.password_hash, users.role, users.access_level, users.company_name, users.phone, users.phone_extension, users.shipping_name, users.shipping_address, users.billing_address, users.shipping_same_as_billing, users.assigned_promo_code, users.assigned_discount_percent, users.approval_status, users.approval_decided_at, users.approval_decided_by_user_id, users.is_active, users.created_at 
FROM users 
WHERE users.is_active = ? ORDER BY users.display_name ASC

SELECT users.id, users.display_name, users.email, users.username, users.password_hash, users.role, users.access_level, users.company_name, users.phone, users.phone_extension, users.shipping_name, users.shipping_address, users.billing_address, users.shipping_same_as_billing, users.assigned_promo_code, users.assigned_discount_percent, users.approval_status, users.approval_decided_at, users.approval_decided_by_user_id, users.is_active, users.created_at 
FROM users 
WHERE users.role = ? AND users.is_active IS ? AND (lower(users.username) = ? OR lower(users.email) = ?)
UPDATE users SET access_level=? WHERE users.id = ?
UPDATE users SET password_hash=? WHERE users.id = ?

INSERT INTO users (display_name, email, username, password_hash, role, access_level, company_name, phone, phone_extension, shipping_name, shipping_address, billing_address, shipping_same_as_billing, assigned_promo_code, assigned_discount_percent, approval_status, approval_decided_at, approval_decided_by_user_id, is_active, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) RETURNING id
